# MCP tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_mcp_docs.py; do not edit by hand. -->

Conventions: a resume is addressed by `version_name` (file stem, no
`.yaml`). Text tools take an optional `section_id`; omit it to work on
the whole-resume text view. Failures are returned as MCP tool errors
with an actionable message.

## Versions

### `list_resume_versions`

_read-only_

List all stored resume versions.

### `create_resume_version`

_writes_

Create a new resume version from the blank standard template.

To start from existing content, use copy_resume_version instead.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |

### `copy_resume_version`

_writes_

Copy an existing resume version to a new version name.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source_version` | string | yes | Existing version to copy. |
| `target_version` | string | yes | New version name; must not exist yet. |

### `delete_resume_version`

_writes, destructive_

Permanently delete a resume version. The base 'resume' version cannot
be deleted.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |

## Reading

### `load_complete_resume`

_read-only_

Render a resume version as read-only Markdown, with its layout
(section order / hidden sections) applied.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |

### `list_resume_sections`

_read-only_

List the sections of a version with their id, type, title, whether they
are rendered, and a Markdown format hint for editing.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |

### `read_resume_text`

_read-only_

Read the editable Markdown text of a whole resume or of one section.

Use this before replace/insert/delete_resume_text to copy exact snippets.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |
| `section_id` | string \| null | no | Section id to target one section; omit to target the whole-resume text view. (default `None`) |

## Editing

### `replace_resume_text`

_writes_

Replace one exact text snippet in the resume text view.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |
| `old_text` | string | yes | Exact snippet to replace; must match exactly once. |
| `new_text` | string | yes | Replacement text. |
| `section_id` | string \| null | no | Section id to target one section; omit to target the whole-resume text view. (default `None`) |

### `insert_resume_text`

_writes_

Insert text at the start/end of the text view, or before/after an anchor.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |
| `new_text` | string | yes | Text to insert. |
| `position` | `start` \| `end` \| `before` \| `after` | yes | Where to insert, relative to the text or the anchor. |
| `anchor_text` | string \| null | no | Required for before/after; must match exactly once. (default `None`) |
| `section_id` | string \| null | no | Section id to target one section; omit to target the whole-resume text view. (default `None`) |

### `delete_resume_text`

_writes_

Delete one exact text snippet from the resume text view.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |
| `old_text` | string | yes | Exact snippet to delete; must match exactly once. |
| `section_id` | string \| null | no | Section id to target one section; omit to target the whole-resume text view. (default `None`) |

### `update_resume_section`

_writes_

Rewrite one whole section from Markdown. Prefer the text tools for
small edits. Only one section can be updated per call.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |
| `section_id` | string | yes | Section id, e.g. 'header', 'summary', 'skills', 'experience'. See list_resume_sections. |
| `new_content` | string | yes | Complete new Markdown for the section, following the format_hint from list_resume_sections. |

## Layout

### `get_resume_layout`

_read-only_

Get the section order and hidden sections used when rendering.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |

### `set_section_visibility`

_writes_

Show or hide a section when rendering. Returns the updated layout.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |
| `section_id` | string | yes | Section id, e.g. 'header', 'summary', 'skills', 'experience'. See list_resume_sections. |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | True to show, False to hide. (default `True`) |

### `set_section_order`

_writes_

Set the rendering order of sections. Returns the updated layout.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |
| `order` | string[] | yes | Section ids in the desired order. Unknown ids are skipped; unlisted sections follow in their current order. |

## Semantic search

### `build_vector_index`

_writes_

Build or refresh the semantic index of experience/project entries.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `force_rebuild` | boolean | no | Re-embed every chunk instead of reusing cache. (default `False`) |

### `search_resume_entries`

_read-only_

Semantic search over experience/project entries across all versions.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Natural-language search query. |
| `entry_type` | `experience` \| `projects` \| `all` | no |  (default `all`) |
| `chunk_level` | `entry` \| `bullet` | no | Match whole entries or individual bullets. (default `entry`) |
| `top_k` | integer | no |  (default `5`) |

### `get_vector_index_status`

_read-only_

Report whether the semantic index exists and is up to date.

## Rendering

### `render_resume_pdf`

_writes, external services_

Compile a resume version to PDF, upload it, and return a download link.

Returns `public_url`, `filename`, `pdf_path` and `latex_assets_dir`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |

### `render_resume_to_overleaf`

_writes, external services_

Export a resume version as a LaTeX project and return an Overleaf link.

Returns `overleaf_url`, `public_url`, `filename`, `zip_path` and
`latex_assets_dir`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version_name` | string | yes | Resume version name without .yaml, e.g. 'resume'. |

## Help & diagnostics

### `get_resume_yaml_format`

_read-only_

Documentation of the resume YAML format: JSON schema, section types and
a complete example.

### `diagnose_filesystems`

_read-only_

Report storage configuration and contents, for troubleshooting.

### `call_me_at_the_first_time_when_you_are_chatgpt`

_read-only_

REQUIRED first call for ChatGPT clients: returns the usage guide for
this server. Call it once before using any other tool.
